notes.title: [Version 1.3.0a] Yes, Brother Major Update #2
notes.notes:
It’s a pleasure to announce that the second Major Update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343410/Yes_Brother/]Yes, Brother[/url] is now live! Check out what has changed:

[list]
[*] All tilesets have been changed: now you’ll play a game with Male Doll’s original assets;
[*] All pixel art characters have been changed: now all NPCs have new sprites. Since we’ve been working on new ones, you won’t notice big differences in sprite variation. In the next updates some will be added, specially for children and old people.
[*] Skin tones variations: now there are three types of skin tones. RPG Maker is known by its white characters, but we are a brand that focuses on differences. This means we’ve been working on skin tones variations and for the first time, we have a game with people of color!
[*] Some places have changed a little bit: since there are some sprites we hadn’t made yet (like the wooden partitions used in the church), we changed these places a little bit to fit in the assets we had.
[*] The DLC page will be removed from the store and the NSFW content will be available in the main game page
[/list]
Animations, concept arts and scenes are still the same as the old version. They will be changed in our final major update with the new part of the game. Also, the ‘Yes, Brother’ price will increase by 1 dollar soon.

[b]IMPORTANT NOTES:[/b]

[list]
[*] If you have a save and want to play the game again, it’s recommended you start a new one. 
[*] If you find any bugs, please, join [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] to report them or use the game forum.
[*] If you want to check more about the game/story major updates, you can read the full post here.
[/list]

Thank you all for supporting us and we hope you enjoy our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll/list/58737]upcoming releases.[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704310/Burning_Horns_A_Bara_Isekai_JRPG/

Don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll]Steam page[/url], we’re getting closer to 600 followers!

notes.title: BIG changes for Yes, Brother + New Price!
notes.notes:
Before we started [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343410/Yes_Brother/]Yes, Brother[/url], our idea was to create a sequel to explore not only Alberto’s and Isaac’s adventure, but also introduce them to a new place (no spoilers!). We believe this would be a rich experience since we want to expand the game universe, so we created [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1543690/Bara_Giants/]Bara Giants[/url] to connect it to Yes, Brother. Our goal was to create a 3rd game in which Alberto, Isaac, and William (Isaac’s brother from Bara Giants) meet each other and end their adventure together. 

However, Bara Giants brought us a new audience (macrophilia community) and we’ve decided to end the Yes, Brother adventure in this game. In the near future, we’ll launch 3 major updates that will change relevant things from Yes, Brother story, and today we would like to introduce you to 2 of them.

[olist]
[*] The 1st one is Bara Giants which will receive an update on the Halloween sale and William’s story will not end the way it ends.
[*] The 2nd one is Yes, Brother which will receive a visual update for all pixel art assets (tilesets and characters). As you saw on Bara Giants, we’ve been making our own tilesets, so Yes, Brother will have the same aesthetic of Bara Giants. 
[/olist]
Check out some photos about the visual update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38027408/b07ef802e227a158ee0333ca74c32695006312a8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38027408/07b83de536632962ba773dd916ee6d3378ad32b6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38027408/577476b88e5beec8c1afaa24d9627d0fc888b727.png[/img]

There will be a MAJOR update for Yes, Brother in which a lot of things will be added, but we’ll post about this when we have more things ready.

[b]The visual update will happen on the Halloween Sale (on October 28th) and because of that, the game price will be increased by 1 dollar totalizing $3,99.[/b] If you have already purchased the game, you will not pay anything else for it, you will just have to download it again. (Sale files will be lost or will not work properly.)

We hope you all enjoy these changes and don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll]Steam page[/url] to get the latest news.

New games will be announced soon!

Male Doll Team

notes.title: 2 years old and 2 presents for you!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38027408/1fe658d2264611553ed203f708d79919f7be125a.png[/img]

Hello, guys.

On January 17th Male Doll will complete 2 years old. After so many years trying to create a studio in which LGBTQ+ people (like me) could create games and live from their dreams, I finally got it. Today, we are a small team from Brazil working on games that we can relate to, especially when we are talking about products not based on visual mechanics and dating simulators.

We believe games are platforms to talk about diversity and differences and we work everyday to make other LGBTQ+ devs have the opportunity that we didn't have when we were kids.

However, this wouldn’t happen without each of you who have been supporting us every day and giving honest feedback about what we create. We really appreciate everyone who helped us directly and indirectly on this journey. Thank you!

To celebrate this moment, we have two presents for you!

First, we’ve started a raffle on [url=https://discord.gg/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] in which 2 people will receive a copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280640/Boyfriends_Rescue___Gay_Platform_Game]Boyfriend’s Rescue[/url], our main project from 2020! If you want to give it a shot, we’ll be glad to welcome you. Also, don’t forget to react to Giveaway Bot’s comment. This raffle ends on Monday 18th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280640/Boyfriends_Rescue___Gay_Platform_Game/

Second, our [url=https://www.redbubble.com/people/MaleDollStudio/]shop[/url] is now live! Yeaaah! You can check some products that we’ve made for you like bottoms, t-shirts, spiral notebooks and much more! Check it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38027408/86689a15dd27ba9c77157d063c4687cc2d4dcee7.png[/img]

Thank you all for being with us and wishlist our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll/list/58737]upcoming release[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468430/Freezer_Pops

Don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll]Steam page[/url], [b]we are about to reach 300 followers![/b]

Cheers,

Victoria
